verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents first-party integrations with Stripe (payments) and with Ramp and Brex (spend and banking-style accounts). These connected sources feed reconciliation and auto-categorization. Payroll data shows up in the ledger (forecasts and MCP tools reference payroll), but no payroll-system integration or direct bank-feed connection is explicitly documented. Missing for 10: an explicit payroll-provider integration, documented direct bank-feed connections, details on automatic sync behavior, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically
